semantics.values: Published index and settlement closes; not traded-security prices, continuous futures, executable quotes or manufactured OHLC.
semantics.units: Volatility index points are distinct from general index points. Metadata currency is not the numeric unit.
semantics.source_time: Original source timestamp retained without inventing its unspecified timezone. Observation dates are calendar labels, not release timestamps.
semantics.source_inconsistencies: Source OHLC contradictions are flagged; valid source closes remain plotable and all original fields remain inspectable.
semantics.volume: The public index histories contain zero volume placeholders; these are not traded volume.
semantics.methodology: Historical methodology versions and backtested/live boundaries remain unverified.
